# ZipZap Protocol (DEX Aggregator) - LLM Reference

> Clean, machine-readable specifications for AI agents interacting with ZipZap contracts without frontend requirements.
> For the comprehensive technical specification with complete ABIs and routing rules, see [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

## Overview
- Project: ZipZap
- Category: Multi-Chain DEX & Convex Split Aggregator
- Chains: Kaia (8217), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Solana (101)
- Platform Tax: 0.00%
- Fee Architecture: Surplus Capture (100% of positive slippage retained, 0% taken from quoted output)

## MCP Server Connection
Agents can run this MCP server via zero-hosting local execution:
```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "zipzap": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "@zipzap-protocol/mcp"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Available MCP Tools
- `zipzap_get_chains`: Returns supported chains, router addresses, and RPCs.
- `zipzap_get_tokens`: Returns token contracts and decimals for a given chainId.
- `zipzap_get_wallet_balance`: Reads native and token balances via public RPCs.
- `zipzap_get_quote`: Queries live on-chain V3 QuoterV2 & V2 routers (EVM) or Jupiter v1 (Solana) with automatic split-routing.
- `zipzap_build_swap_tx`: Generates executable calldata for EVM ZipZapRouter.sol (with live ERC-20 allowance check) or serialized Solana VersionedTransaction.
- `zipzap_crosschain_quote`: Fetches live cross-chain bridge quotes (Across / Stargate / LI.FI) across EVM and Solana.
- `zipzap_simulate_swap`: Dry-runs a built EVM (`eth_call` + gas estimate) or Solana (`simulateTransaction`) swap before signing.
- `zipzap_get_tx_status`: Checks confirmation status and decodes `ZipZapRouter` `SwapExecuted` logs (actual output & surplus captured).
